scripts.hook: Think you can crack the perfect AI prompt in 30 seconds?
scripts.body: Introduce the weekly Prompt Challenge, show a quick demo of a sample prompt, break down why it works, then ask viewers to submit their own prompts in the comments. Highlight the best solutions in a carousel recap later in the week.
scripts.cta: Drop your prompt below and vote for your favorite in tomorrow's Story poll!

scripts.hook: AI ethics myth #1: It’s all about privacy—false!
scripts.body: State the myth, debunk it with a fast fact‑check and a real‑world example, overlay bold text for emphasis, and use a quick voice‑over to keep the pace snappy. Pin the series to Highlights for easy access.
scripts.cta: Comment your biggest AI concern and follow for more myth‑busting reels!

scripts.hook: ChatGPT vs Claude vs Gemini—who wins the writing showdown?
scripts.body: Set a common task (e.g., drafting a product description), run each tool side‑by‑side, flash the outputs in a split‑screen Reel, and point out strengths/weaknesses in 5‑second bursts. End with a poll sticker asking viewers to pick the winner.
scripts.cta: Vote in the poll, tag a friend to debate, and stay tuned for the next battle!
